title: E01 Adjudication Output Record
description: Validates one ADJUDICATOR-EU-01 output record, one per audited ecosystem (system under test, SUT), written to derived-data/adjudication/<SUT>/adjudication.json (manifests/e01-adjudication-output-contract-v1.yaml; protocol/unresolved.md, PROTO-U01). For every examined modality cell, records whether it is CONFIRMED, DISPUTED, or UNSUPPORTED (protocol/agent-governance-v1.md, section 3.3), referenced by evidence_id only -- never by CSV row or line number (protocol/evidence-rules-v1.md). Introduces no new scoring concept, evidence status, or outcome category beyond those already required by section 3.3; does not alter provisional_score or confirmed_score semantics, the capability rubric, or the tie-break rule. Distinct from, and does not modify, the adjudication object in schemas/sut-audit.schema.json, which remains unchanged.

adjudicator_role.description: Agent role that produced this record, from protocol/agent-governance-v1.md.

ecosystem_id.description: Identifier of the audited ecosystem (system under test) this record adjudicates.

cell_outcomes.description: One entry per examined modality cell for this ecosystem (protocol/agent-governance-v1.md, section 3.3).

modality.description: Modality of the examined cell, per protocol/study-design-v1.md.

outcome.description: Adjudication outcome for this cell (protocol/agent-governance-v1.md, section 3.3): CONFIRMED when the auditor's confirmed_score is upheld; DISPUTED when flagged for human decision; UNSUPPORTED when the provisional score is not supported by its cited evidence records.

evidence_ids.description: evidence_id values (protocol/evidence-rules-v1.md) of every evidence record involved in this outcome. CSV row or line numbers are never used.

note.description: Adjudicator's free-text note on this cell. Null if none.

notes.description: Adjudicator's free-text notes for the record as a whole. Null if none.
